annotations.title: Prove a shop's domain with a meta tag or a file

description: After register_shop: publish <meta name="fordeal-verification" content="TOKEN"> on the shop's home page, or the token as the whole content of https://DOMAIN/fordeal-verification.txt, then call this with the domain and the token from `verification.ownership`. One request to each address with Fordeal's identified bot (www. and the bare host). The answer: ok with the method (meta | file, or already), or `error.code` not_found (no request with this domain and token) | not_verified (neither place carries the token; a CDN cache may take minutes). Proving the domain marks the request as confirmed, like the e-mail link; the operator still decides. Public.

token.description: The token from verification.ownership of the registration answer.
